Ministry of Communications
CSL

The Government of India deeply regret to record the premature death, by heart failure, of Shri S. P. Patel, Postmaster-General, Bombay Circle, at Bombay on Friday, the 12th February 1960 at 11 P.M. He was due to retire on the 9th October l960.
